producten.sub: A complete ecosystem of hardware that works together seamlessly. From battery to charger, everything from one partner, one contract, one invoice.
producten.label: Keep reading
producten.lead: Lemnion delivers a fully integrated energy system. Every component is designed to work together seamlessly. No compatibility issues, no finger-pointing between suppliers.
producten.c1p: The safest battery technology on the market. Modularly scalable from 60 kWh to 1 MWh+. Including a 6-layer safety system with UL 9540A certification.
producten.c2p: The only programmable EMS specifically for hotels. No fixed profiles, but custom Python strategies per location. Full API integration with your PMS.
producten.c3p: Future-proof chargers with OCPP 2.0.1. Suitable for all EV brands. Including a 7″ display for hotel marketing while charging.
producten.c4p: MPPT directly on the battery's DC bus. No conversion losses from DC to AC and back, so maximum yield from every kWh generated.
producten.c5p: Industrial bidirectional inverters. They convert stored direct current into usable alternating current for your hotel. Efficient and reliable.
producten.c6p: 24/7 remote monitoring of all components. Automatic alerts, monthly reports and preventive maintenance. We keep an eye on everything.
producten.ctah: Ready to free your hotel from grid congestion?
producten.ctap: Calculate in 1 minute what your hotel can save with its own energy system.
